svg.title: Rumor Mill Flour Co. share certificate
svg.desc: A joke share certificate of RUMOR MILL FLOUR CO., printed in one ink with a red wax seal. The vignette shows a windmill with four lattice sails on a hill, with two sacks of flour at its foot. Under the name it says THIS CERTIFIES NOTHING, and a sheet of five numbered coupons hangs below a perforation.
